card.name: Inside Portuguese and Spanish title words
card.fires_on: Partway through non-English words, mostly Portuguese or Spanish names and titles (e.g. enxertinho, Poema, Quarteto) and some Greek. It appears in web-text about culture and botany, not drug labels.

modes.label: Portuguese/Spanish word endings
modes.description: Part-way through Portuguese or Spanish words in titles or plant names.

modes.label: Greek transliteration
modes.description: Inside a Greek word in a quoted translation title.

card.writes: It promotes dose-related tokens like dos, dose and dosage, which looks unrelated to these contexts.
card.plain: It fires inside foreign-language words such as Portuguese or Spanish titles, and has no link to dosing in these texts.
